01地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月21日

霍尔木兹再遭两起油轮袭击，50 分钟内两度中弹

Two Tanker Incidents Reported Near Oman; Vessel Hit Mine East Of Hormuz

An outbound tanker was hit on its stern by an unidentified projectile about 11 nautical miles north of Oman's Khasab on Saturday (UKMTO Warning 215-26, 0500 UTC), and about 50 minutes later another tanker was hit in its engine room about 17 nautical miles east of Khasab (Warning 216-26, 0550 UTC), UKMTO said; it was not immediately clear whether the two reports involved the same vessel, with no casualties reported and environmental impact unknown in either incident. Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in a restricted area east of the strait, which Reuters could not independently verify or link to the UKMTO incidents. These are new 21 November attacks, distinct from the 20 November fire carried yesterday; a later navigational warning named the tanker TORKEL (IMO 9340635) as burning at anchor (NAVAREA IX 457/26, via specialist reporting on 22 November, not yet named by UKMTO or Reuters).

UKMTO 称，一艘驶出霍尔木兹海峡的油轮周六在阿曼 Khasab 以北约 11 海里遭不明投射物击中船尾（警告 215-26，05:00 UTC）；约 50 分钟后，另一艘油轮在 Khasab 以东约 17 海里机舱中弹（警告 216-26，05:50 UTC），尚不清楚两起报告是否涉及同一艘船，两起均无伤亡报告、环境影响未明。伊朗海军称一艘油轮在海峡以东限制区触雷起火，Reuters 称无法独立核实伊方说法、也无法确认是否指 UKMTO 所报事件。本条为 11-21 新发生的两起袭击，与昨日已刊 11-20 油轮起火（214-26）不同；后续航行警告称涉事船 TORKEL（IMO 9340635）起火锚泊（NAVAREA IX 457/26，经专业情报汇总 DeepDraft 11-22 引用，UKMTO/Reuters 尚未具名确认，发布时须标注未证实）。

02地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月21日

俄军方关联货船 Sparta II 在芬兰湾遭无人机袭击起火

Russian Military-Linked Cargo Ship Burns After Suspected Drone Strike in Gulf of Finland

The Russian-flagged ro-ro cargo ship Sparta II (IMO 9160994), linked to defence logistics firm Oboronlogistika and sanctioned by the United States in 2022, was struck by drones in international waters west of Gogland Island in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, caught fire, lost manoeuvrability and drifted into Finnish territorial waters before anchoring off Loviisa, where the Finnish Border Guard led rescue operations and set up a restricted area as all 16 crew transferred by lifeboat to a nearby cargo ship; Finnish officials said Ukraine was likely responsible, with no public confirmation from Kyiv, and the cargo was undisclosed, with military materiel not ruled out. A Russian helicopter was later suspected of entering Finnish airspace by about 4.1 km, Finland reimposed temporary air and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland and notified allies, and reported no environmental damage and no danger to other shipping, with Russia intending to tow the vessel back to Russian waters. The ship was sailing from St Petersburg to Kaliningrad; the Gulf of Finland is a key Russian corridor to the Baltic via St Petersburg, Ust-Luga and Primorsk.

俄罗斯旗滚装货船 Sparta II（IMO 9160994，关联俄国防部物流企业 Oboronlogistika，2022 年遭美国制裁）周六在芬兰湾 Gogland 岛以西国际水域遭无人机袭击起火，失去操纵后漂入芬兰领海并在 Loviisa 外锚泊，芬兰边防卫队主导救援并划设限制区，16 名船员经救生艇转移至附近货船；芬方称袭击很可能由乌克兰实施，基辅未公开确认，船上货物未披露、不能排除军用物资。事发后一架俄直升机被疑进入芬兰空约 4.1 公里，芬兰恢复东部芬兰湾临时航空与海事限制并通知盟友；芬方称未发现环境损害、对其他航运无危险，俄方拟将该船拖回俄水域。该船原由圣彼得堡驶往加里宁格勒，芬兰湾是俄经圣彼得堡、Ust-Luga 与 Primorsk 通往波罗的海的重要航道。

胡塞向利雅得发射三枚导弹被拦截，红海港口威胁持续

Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh

Following yesterday's Hodeidah strikes and the Houthi claim on Jazan, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles fired towards Riyadh early on Saturday, the third day of emergency alerts in the capital after a Houthi strike damaged the sovereign wealth fund tower two days earlier, and hours later destroyed another drone fired towards the kingdom's south without naming the province. Houthi-run media said an air strike hit the Red Sea port of Mokha, and the United Nations said it was following the escalation with concern, warning that continued fighting could threaten vital humanitarian supply routes in Yemen. Houthi threats against Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports and the Al-Shuqaiq power plant were carried yesterday and are not counted as new here; no commercial vessel strike or Saudi port closure has been confirmed.

本条为昨日荷台达打击与胡塞声称打击 Jazan 的跟进，新点有三：沙特联军称周六凌晨拦截三枚射向利雅得的胡塞弹道导弹（利雅得连续第三天发布紧急警报，此前两日胡塞袭击曾损毁利雅得主权基金大楼），数小时后又摧毁一架射向沙特南部的一无人机（未指明省份）；胡塞媒体称联军空袭命中红海 Mokha 港；联合国称正关切关注升级，警告持续战斗可能威胁也门人道援助生命线。胡塞对吉达等沙特红海港口及 Shuqaiq 电站的威胁为昨日已刊内容，本条不重复计为新事件；尚无商船遇袭或沙特港口关闭的确认报道。

04地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月21日

MIRO G 脱浅受阻：发电机故障、拖轮难近，仍需数日

MIRO G Cargo Ship Aground in France: Salvage Operation Hampered by Weather and Generator Failure

Following yesterday's grounding report, another 11 people including the captain, the two remaining crew, salvage specialists and company representatives were airlifted off on Saturday with no injuries; salvors have pumped seawater into ballast tanks to stabilise the vessel against capsizing or moving closer to the beach, but failure of its two main generators has left the pumps without power while engineers work to restore an alternative supply. The French salvage tug Abeille Bretagne has arrived with a 1,000-metre towline but shallow water keeps it about 900 metres from the ship, officials warn refloating could take several days or more with no guarantee of success, and the beach at Cap de l'Homy is closed. French naval aerial monitoring has still detected no pollution; the grounding sequence, the first 19-person evacuation and the more than 100 tonnes of diesel risk carried yesterday are not repeated.

本条为昨日 MIRO G 搁浅的跟进，新点有四：周六又有 11 人（含船长、其余 2 名船员、救助专家与公司代表）直升机撤离，无人受伤；救助方已向压载舱注水稳船以防倾覆或更贴近海滩，但两台主机发电机故障使水泵无电、工程师正恢复备用电源；法国救助拖轮 Abeille Bretagne 已抵达并备 1,000 米拖缆，但浅水使其距船约 900 米、拖带困难；官员警告脱浅可能需数日或更久、成功无保证，Cap de l'Homy 海滩已封闭。法海军空中监测仍未发现污染；昨日已刊的搁浅经过、19 人撤离与逾 100 吨柴油风险不重复计。

05地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月22日

巴林称伊朗袭击工业设施，卡塔尔代表团赴德黑兰谈判

Bahrain says Iran struck industrial site as tankers hit in Hormuz

Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial facility on Saturday, causing a fire but no casualties without specifying the location, while residents told AFP they saw smoke over Sitra Island on the east coast, home to industrial sites including a refinery run by state oil company Bapco, and Iran's Fars news agency reported the Revolutionary Guards had attacked two US bases, Sheikh Isa and Juffair, on the island; neither account was independently verified. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said a Qatari delegation visited Tehran the previous evening and held two hours of talks without details, while Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said regional talks must be given a chance and the blockade lifted rationally, restating that discussion of opening Hormuz is pointless unless Iran's demands are met, including ending the war on all fronts, unfreezing assets, lifting oil sanctions and ending the US counter-blockade of Iranian ports. Iran also said it shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island on Saturday, according to state TV, unverified, while US Central Command said last month it had helped Gulf countries export 1.5 billion barrels of oil via Hormuz since the summer. The new points are the Bahrain strike claim and the Qatari mediation talks; the two Hormuz tanker hits are carried in story 01 and not repeated.

巴林指控伊朗周六袭击一处民用工业设施并引发火灾（无伤亡，未指明地点；居民对 AFP 称东海岸 Sitra 岛上空见烟，该岛有国营 Bapco 炼厂等工业设施），伊朗 Fars 通讯社则称革命卫队袭击了巴林 Sheikh Isa 与 Juffair 两处美军基地，均未独立证实。伊朗副外长 Gharibabadi 称卡塔尔代表团前晚抵德黑兰并谈了两小时（未披露细节），外长 Araghchi 称地区谈判应有机会、封锁须理性解除，并重申伊方要求未满足前讨论霍尔木兹开放毫无意义（要求包括结束各线战争、解冻资产、解除石油制裁、结束美对伊港口反封锁）。伊朗另称周六在海峡 Qeshm 岛上空击落一架美军无人机（州电视台，未独立证实）；美军称上月已协助海湾国家经霍尔木兹出口 15 亿桶石油。本条新点为巴林袭击指控与卡塔尔调解谈判，霍尔木兹两起油轮袭击本身已见第 01 条、不重复计。

06能源、油气与LNG · 2026年11月21日

洛杉矶港发布 Phillips 66 油码头重建环评草案，最长可运营40年

Los Angeles opens review of Phillips 66 oil terminal rebuild

The Port of Los Angeles has released a draft environmental impact report for the proposed redevelopment of the Phillips 66 marine oil terminal in Wilmington, including a new tanker berthing facility at Berths 150–151 built to California's Marine Oil Terminal Engineering and Maintenance Standards (MOTEMS), plus upgrades to pipelines, vapour recovery equipment, support systems and storage tanks. The existing wharf at Berths 148–149 would keep handling oil tankers during construction and be restricted to non-oil uses once the new facility enters service, while the proposal includes a new 20-year operating entitlement with two optional 10-year extensions, potentially allowing another 40 years of operation. The environmental review began in 2023 and public comments are being accepted until 4 January 2027; the project has not been approved.

洛杉矶港发布 Phillips 66 位于 Wilmington 的海运油码头重建项目环境影响报告草案，拟在 150–151 号泊位新建符合加州《海运油码头工程与维护标准》（MOTEMS）的油轮靠泊设施，并升级管线、油气回收、支持系统与储罐。现有 148–149 号泊位在施工期间继续接卸油轮，新设施投用后改为非油码头用途；项目包含新的20年运营许可加两次10年续期选项，最长可再运营40年。环评流程自2023年启动，公众意见征集至2027年1月4日，尚未获批。

07油轮、干散货与运价市场 · 2026年11月21日

Frontline 三季度净利 6.414 亿美元，四季度 VLCC 订舱均价 56.26 万美元/天

Frontline: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

Frontline reported third-quarter net profit of $641.4 million ($2.88 per share; adjusted profit $530.9 million), with third-quarter spot TCE averaging $148,500 a day for VLCCs, $102,500 for suezmaxes and $67,800 for LR2/Aframax vessels; fourth-quarter bookings stood at 68% of VLCC days at $562,600 a day, 69% of suezmax days at $324,300 and 68% of LR2/Aframax days at $190,800, with management expecting a record quarter. Chief executive Lars Barstad said Hormuz risks have pushed Middle East producers to buy their own tanker tonnage, with about 70 VLCCs engaged in Hormuz shuttle operations (nearly 10% of the fleet under 20 years old and almost 20% of the actively traded fleet); the revolving credit facility was expanded to $2.3 billion with $1.4 billion of liquidity, the fleet stands at 51 vessels (14 VLCCs, 19 suezmaxes and 18 Aframax/LR2s) at an average cash breakeven of about $23,600 a day, and the global orderbook for its classes averages about 27% of active fleet capacity while severe Asian shipyard labour shortages limit delivery speed. This is a results and rates signal from a different company than yesterday's Star Bulk and Hafnia reports.

Frontline 三季度净利 6.414 亿美元（2.88 美元/股，调整后净利 5.309 亿美元），三季度即期 TCE 均价为 VLCC 148,500 美元/天、苏伊士型 102,500 美元/天、LR2/Aframax 67,800 美元/天；四季度已订舱比例与均价分别为 VLCC 68% 天数 562,600 美元/天、苏伊士型 69% 天数 324,300 美元/天、LR2/Aframax 68% 天数 190,800 美元/天，管理层称四季度将创纪录。首席执行官 Lars Barstad 称霍尔木兹风险使中东产油国转而自购油轮运力，约 70 艘 VLCC 参与霍尔木兹穿梭运输（占 20 年以下船队近 10%、活跃交易船队近 20%）；公司循环信贷额度扩至 23 亿美元、流动性 14 亿美元，船队 51 艘（VLCC 14 艘、苏伊士型 19 艘、Aframax/LR2 18 艘），平均现金盈亏平衡约 23,600 美元/天；其经营船型的全球订单簿平均约占活跃船队运力 27%，但亚洲船厂严重缺工限制交付速度。本条为业绩与运价信号，与昨日 Star Bulk/Hafnia 业绩为不同公司事件。

Southern California port employers, watchmen union reach tentative deal

The Pacific Maritime Association said on Saturday it had reached a tentative agreement with ILWU Local 26, representing about 250 security officers or watchmen who control terminal gate access, conduct security patrols and report safety issues, averting a strike that could have disrupted the two busiest US cargo hubs; the deal is subject to ratification by Local 26 members with the current contract extended pending ratification, and the union did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Cochin Port strike nears 2 weeks: Million-dollar losses feared as shipping lines, importers mull other options

Container truck drivers at Cochin Port's Vallarpadam International Container Transshipment Terminal have been on indefinite strike since 9 November, entering a 12th day on Saturday with 1,810 containers piled up at the terminal, many of them reefers carrying perishables such as fruit, as reefer and demurrage charges mount (about ₹588–₹886 per container per four-hour slab for refrigeration, plus demurrage of about ₹836–₹1,372 from the eighth day of storage, doubling seven days later) and traders warn losses could reach millions of dollars. Shipping lines and importers are exploring alternative South Indian ports such as V.O. Chidambaranar Port in Tamil Nadu, while the Cochin Chamber of Commerce and Industry appealed to the central and state governments to intervene and sought a waiver of container charges. The strike stems from Cochin's selection as a pilot site for compulsory drive-through scanning of all import containers, with drivers complaining of body pain, headaches and nausea, while the Customs Directorate of Logistics says safeguards against unsafe radiation exposure are in place.

Chidambaranar 港），CCCI 呼吁中央与邦政府介入并请求免除码头集装箱费用。罢工起因是科钦港被列为进口集装箱强制扫描试点（司机需多次驾车穿过扫描仪，司机投诉身体疼痛、头痛与恶心；海关物流局称系统已有辐射防护）。

Kpler's $1.5bn-plus investment crosses finish line

Maritime data and analytics specialist Kpler has completed its investment deal with US private capital firm Sixth Street, which acquired more than $1.5bn worth of shares, closing one of the largest investment transactions involving a maritime technology company in recent years. First announced in June at more than $1bn (when Kpler was valued at around $3.85bn), the deal brings Sixth Street in alongside existing investor Insight Partners, founders François Cazor and Jean Maynier and management, while Five Arrows exits; Kpler remains independent with leadership and strategy unchanged, and the transaction is a share acquisition rather than a $1.5bn cash injection, with no revised valuation or ownership percentage disclosed. 美国 FCC 放宽船用低轨卫星频谱，新增50MHz

US clears more bandwidth for ships using LEO networks

The US Federal Communications Commission has approved an expansion of satellite spectrum access for ships, allowing terminals on moving vessels an additional 50 MHz when communicating with non-geostationary satellite networks and removing a restriction dating back to 2020. Earth Stations in Motion will be permitted across the full 28.35–28.6 GHz band with non-geostationary satellites including low-earth-orbit constellations, up from the previous 28.4–28.6 GHz limit, increasing available spectrum in the range from 200 MHz to 250 MHz, a 25% expansion; the FCC had held back the lower 50 MHz over interference concerns but concluded after a technical review that protections for existing users can be maintained. The move comes as owners shift to hybrid connectivity combining LEO networks, conventional VSAT and backups — Wallenius Wilhelmsen completed a Starlink and Eutelsat OneWeb upgrade across 41 ro-ro vessels in October — though the FCC notes it does not guarantee faster connections for individual vessels and applies to US-regulated spectrum.

美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）批准扩大船舶卫星频谱接入，允许移动船舶终端在与非静止轨道卫星网络通信时多用50MHz 容量，撤销2020年以来的限制。新规下「运动中地球站」（ESIM）可在完整的 28.35–28.6 GHz 频段内与低轨星座等非静止轨道卫星通信，此前仅限 28.4–28.6 GHz，该频段可用频谱由200MHz 增至250MHz（扩25%）；FCC 此前因担心干扰地面无线业务而保留低端50MHz，复核技术证据后认定可保留对现有用户的保护。背景是商船卫星宽带快速扩张，船东转向低轨+传统 VSAT+备份的混合连接（如 Wallenius Wilhelmsen 10月完成41艘滚装船 Starlink 与 Eutelsat OneWeb 升级）；FCC 指出新规不保证单船网速提升，且仅适用于美国监管频谱。
